settings.heading: Half of the world's seafood comes from farms - only a fraction of a fraction meets the Seatopia Standard™.

settings.text:
Seatopia is the only seafood company in the world that lab tests to ensure your seafood is omega rich, mercury safe, free from detectable microplastics.

We lab test our seafood to ensure that it meets the Seatopia Standard. We believe that testing provides transparency, accountability, and most importantly piece of mind so that you can enjoy delicious seafood at home.

settings.heading: Mercury-safe
settings.text: ≤0.1 ppm (≈10x stricter than FDA's 1.0 ppm limit)

settings.heading: Nutrient Verified
settings.text: omega-3s (DHA+EPA), selenium, vitamin D per serving, COA-backed

Because nothing else was comprehensive enough. FDA, EPA, BAP, and ASC each cover pieces of safety or sustainability, but none of them cover the whole.

We built the Seatopia Standard to deliver the full picture: what's in your food, and what isn't.

settings.liquid:
Testing Pillar Other Standards The Seatopia Standard What It Means
Mercury FDA action level: ≤1.0 ppm Every supplier tested to ≤0.1 ppm Nearly 10x stricter than the FDA's legal limit
Microplastics Not addressed Non-detect down to 1 micron (0.001mm) No microplastics detected in fish tested at the farm or on delivery
Artificial Colors & Dyes Permitted via CO or smoke treatment None used in feed or post-harvest Color comes only from natural feed sources — never added
Nutrient Density Rarely measured or disclosed Tested for omega-3s, vitamin D, selenium, protein Nutrition claims backed by lab data, not estimates
Parasite Control Not disclosed Controlled feed sourcing + temperature protocols Minimized risk of parasites and bacteria
Testing Frequency Not disclosed / inconsistent Tested at onboarding, then random inspection annually per farm Ongoing compliance, not a one-time check

Results based on third-party Certificates of Analysis. Nutrient values may vary by lot. This information is for educational purposes only and has not been evaluated by the FDA.

settings.heading: Free From Detectable Microplastics
settings.text:
Our third-party lab partners use validated spectroscopic techniques to screen for microplastic particles down to a quantitation limit of 0.009 particles per gram.

Only products with non-detectable levels above this strict threshold meet the Seatopia Standard.

settings.heading: Mercury Safe
settings.text:
We regularly test samples from every farm partner for mercury content. We partner with ISO-17025 accredited labs like Light Labs to analyze seafood samples down to parts-per-billion precision using industry-standard methods like ICP-MS (Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry) and Cold Vapor Atomic Absorption Spectroscopy.

A sample from every farm is screened to confirm it meets the Seatopia Standard: ≤0.1 ppm mercury—well below FDA limits and far safer than most wild seafood. This means you can enjoy clean, nutrient-rich seafood without worrying about mercury buildup over time.

settings.heading: Nutrient Rich
settings.text:
We lab test to measure key nutrients that support brain, heart, and immune health. Each serving of Seatopia seafood contains verified levels of:

Omega-3s (DHA + EPA) - Essential fatty acids linked to cognitive function, cardiovascular health, and inflammation reduction

Complete Protein - High-quality, bioavailable protein for muscle repair and sustained energy

Vitamin D - Often called the "sunshine vitamin," crucial for immunity, mood, and calcium absorption

Selenium - A powerful antioxidant that supports metabolism and helps protect against oxidative stress

Nutrient values are based on independent lab analyses (Light Labs COAs) and may vary by lot. These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This information is for educational purposes only and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Please consult your healthcare provider for personalized guidance, especially during pregnancy.
